GOOD TO KNOW

Frequently asked questions.

Is the website price a monthly fee?

No. Website development is a once-off cost. Optional monthly maintenance is priced separately.

Is a domain name included?

Domain registration and renewal are quoted separately based on the domain extension and registrar. We recommend registering the domain in your business's name.

Do I need a maintenance plan?

No. Maintenance is optional. If you don't choose a plan, future changes or technical work can be quoted separately.

How long does a website take?

Typical targets are 2–3 working days for Starter, 3–5 for Standard and 5–7 for Premium after all required content and assets are received. We confirm the schedule for each project.

Can you add bookings, payments or more complex features?

Yes, depending on requirements. Features such as payment processing, databases, account logins and advanced booking systems require a separate assessment and quotation.

What counts as a revision?

A revision round is a consolidated set of reasonable changes to the agreed design and content. Starter includes one round, Standard two and Premium three. Major scope changes are quoted separately.

What happens if I cancel maintenance?

Monthly maintenance is month-to-month with 30 days' written cancellation notice. We'll explain the handover options and any hosting changes. Your domain and supplied business content remain yours.
